title: Workday Reports Q3 Fiscal 2027 Revenue of $2.705 Billion
summary: Workday reported fiscal Q3 2027 revenue of $2.705 billion, up 11.2%, and raised its fiscal 2027 subscription revenue guidance to $9.958 billion.
body_markdown:
Operating income was $329 million, or 12.1% of revenues, compared with $259 million, or 10.7% of revenues, a year earlier, and included restructuring expenses of $51 million. Non-GAAP operating income was $850 million, or 31.4% of revenues, against $692 million, or 28.5% of revenues. Operating cash flows were $735 million, compared with $588 million, and free cash flows were $691 million, compared with $550 million.


The 12-month subscription revenue backlog was $9.216 billion, up 12.3% from the same period last year, and total subscription revenue backlog was $27.548 billion, up 6.1% year over year. Workday repurchased approximately 3.8 million shares of Class A common stock for $750 million and held $5.643 billion in cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities as of October 31, 2026.


## Why It Matters for WDAY


For the fourth quarter ending January 31, 2027, Workday guided to subscription revenues of $2.600 billion, representing growth of 10%, and a non-GAAP operating margin of 31.7%. "We are raising our fiscal 2027 subscription revenue guidance to $9.958 billion, growth of 13%, and increasing our fiscal 2027 non-GAAP operating margin guidance to 31.5%," CFO Zane Rowe said.
